metadata.sourcePromptSummary: Adaptive Registration Planner: Real Runtime Diagnosis and Complete Repair for Arbitrary Geometries

1_problemDefinition.goal: Generate scale-adaptive, robust alignment locators across every mating interface for arbitrary mold/part geometries without hardcoded model dimensions.
1_problemDefinition.cadContext: Engineering vertical SaaS mold generator engine in Z-up millimeters operating on Manifold CSG solids and BVH distance fields.
1_problemDefinition.expectedOutcome: Complementary key/socket alignment locators placed deterministically on all valid split interfaces or clean failure reporting if geometrically impossible.

geometricConstraints: No locator shall intersect cavity or sprue functional geometry
Locator anchors must lie on exact mating interface plane
Locator radius and depth must respect local wall thickness and minimum manufacturing limits
topologicalConstraints: Resulting mold bodies must remain 2-manifold closed solids with exactly one connected component
No detached fragments or zero-volume slivers
performanceConstraints: Interface detection and candidate layout evaluation under 200ms per pass
Coarse-to-fine adaptive candidate search with early termination

6_algorithmPipeline.description: Detect all planar flush mating interfaces between participating mold body pairs, sorted deterministically by area.
Compute local interface span, usable corridor width, and local wall thickness limits to select adaptive locator radius and depth.
Sample candidates using a coarse-to-fine multi-resolution grid and boundary corridor offsets instead of conservative whole-body AABBs.
Validate each candidate using BVH signed distance fields against true cavity/sprue meshes and external mold body bounds.
Select maximal stable well-spread layout degrading 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 locator count per interface.
Perform Manifold CSG union/subtraction for keys and sockets with 2-manifold topology assertion.

7_failureConditions.condition: Zero candidates survive exact wall thickness and edge clearance validation
7_failureConditions.recoveryAction: Report specific missing ring margin and preserve untouched canonical mold bodies.

7_failureConditions.condition: CSG Boolean creates non-manifold or multi-component geometry
7_failureConditions.recoveryAction: Roll back to input bodies and return detailed diagnostic failure report.

8_edgeCases.scenario: Irregular diagonal or L-shaped cavity mesh occupying central AABB
8_edgeCases.mitigation: Evaluate exact BVH mesh distance rather than projecting full 2D rectangular AABB.

8_edgeCases.scenario: Narrow mold border around large cavity
8_edgeCases.mitigation: Adaptively scale locator radius down to manufacturing minimum policy floor and sample boundary corridors.

transitions: generating -> blocked: geometric impossibility or insufficient wall

decisionClassifications.item: No hardcoded model dimensions in planner
Default conservative FDM printer profile when none specified
